description_en: Modifies the status of a meal application in Alibaba Business Travel
description_zh: 通过调用本接口实现在阿里商旅中修改用餐申请单状态
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen meal-apply-approve --third-part-apply-id 1234 --status 1 --operate-time 2022-07-12_16:12:53 --remark '同意' --user-id 62141 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwis --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MealApplyApprove

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the third-party approval form.

> Use a unique identifier. It is displayed in the application forms, orders, and bills in Alibaba Business Travel.
parameters.description_zh:
三方审批单Id

> 建议录入唯一标识，会在阿里商旅的申请单、订单、账单中展示。
